services.text: Comprehensive coverage for your vehicles, protecting you against accidents, liability, and uninsured motorists.
services.lead: Comprehensive coverage for your vehicles, protecting you against accidents, liability, and uninsured motorists. We look at your limits before we look at the premium, because state minimums are where most of the exposure hides.

questions.q: What happens if I only carry state minimum liability?
questions.a: If you are sued for $500,000 and only have $50,000 in coverage, your personal assets, home, and savings are exposed. We size the limits to what you actually have to lose.

covers.title: Personal liability

covers.title: Quality carriers

questions.q: Why does a cheap Texas home policy cost more in the end?
questions.a: High percentage wind and hail deductibles of 2% or 3% and actual cash value roof schedules mean you could pay tens of thousands out of pocket for storm damage.
Payouts are heavily depreciated. You get the garage sale value of your items, not what it actually costs to replace them.

questions.q: What does a hailstorm cost on a cheap policy?
questions.a: On a $400,000 home with a $35,000 roof replacement, a cheap Texas policy pays about $13,000 after the 2% wind and hail deductible and roof depreciation, leaving you $22,000 out of pocket. With full replacement cost value the policy pays about $27,000 and you pay the $8,000 deductible.

about.title: Over three decades of trusted experience.
text: Since 1994, Coady & Lewis Associates, Inc. has been a cornerstone of the community, providing reliable, independent insurance solutions. For over three decades, we have built our business on a foundation of trust, integrity, and an unwavering commitment to our clients.

As the industry has evolved, so have we, but our core mission remains unchanged: putting our clients first and ensuring they have the education and guidance necessary to protect what matters most. Our long-standing relationships with top-rated carriers allow us to continually deliver exceptional value and peace of mind.
Many agencies compete to offer the absolute lowest price. We don't. We focus on securing the best premium for comprehensive coverage, so you aren't left exposed when disaster strikes.

values.title: Independent focus
values.text: We work for you, not the insurance companies. This means we can shop across multiple carriers to find the perfect coverage at the best rate.

values.title: Personalized service
values.text: Every client is unique. We take the time to understand your specific needs, risks, and goals to craft a truly customized insurance strategy.

values.title: Education first
values.text: Our priority is to educate you. By breaking down complex policy details, we ensure you have the knowledge needed to make informed decisions about your coverage.

facts.heading: Best premium, not cheapest rate
items: Cut-rate policies often strip out essential coverages, impose massive deductibles, and leave you personally liable for tens of thousands of dollars in a claim.
You might save $20 a month on a cheap policy, then face a crippling $5,000 or $10,000 deductible when an emergency strikes.
We structure your policy to provide maximum protection for your assets at a competitive rate, so you have true peace of mind when you need it most.

facts.heading: Partner referral program
facts.text: Built for mortgage and real estate professionals. Give your clients same-day insurance quotes from a trusted local brokerage, and earn monthly gift cards for every qualified referral. Register as a partner for a unique Partner ID and referral link, share it with clients who need insurance during their transaction, and we quote the same day. Partners with 5 or more qualified referrals in a month are entered in a $100 gift card drawing; 10 or more enters the premium $250 drawing.
